plugins.calendarPermission: welliva reads your upcoming events so your coach can plan around what's ahead — travel, exams, big days. Nothing leaves your device.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: welliva uses your location only to fetch local weather, so your coach can suggest indoor or outdoor workouts.

plugins.photosPermission: welliva accesses your photos so you can log a meal from a picture, set a profile picture and add progress photos. A meal photo is read once to identify the foods and is never stored; the rest upload only to your private account storage.
plugins.cameraPermission: welliva uses your camera so you can log a meal by photographing it, and to scan a packaged food's barcode. The picture is read once and is never stored or uploaded.
welliva uses your camera to scan a packaged food's barcode and to log a meal by photographing it. Nothing is recorded or uploaded — the frame is read on your device and discarded.
